about: Per-contact facts for the Han Yue vs Wang Zhiyi commentary. 'measured' comes from TrackNetV3 shuttle tracks (runs/*_ball.csv) and YOLO pose feet projected to court metres; 'reviewed' is a human-style frame review of zoom strips (runs/zoom-*.jpg). Depths are diagnostic projections, not surveyed ground truth. Handedness assumed right-handed for both players.

conventions.court_m: x 0-6.1 image left to right; y 0 far baseline, 6.7 net, 13.4 near baseline
conventions.contact_time: midpoint between last pre-reversal and first post-reversal track frame (about +/-0.03 s)
conventions.display_time: beat display start + (source t - beat source start)
